items.title: 2.6.3.3 Indexing and Slicing with Negative Indices (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of negative indices (PDF 53-54).

blocks.text: Manfi index sequence ke aakhir se ginte hain: -1 aakhri cheez, -2 aakhri se pehli, waghaira.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
fruits = ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry", "Date", "Elderberry"]
print("First fruit:", fruits[0])
print("Last fruit:", fruits[-1])
print(fruits[1:4])    # Banana, Cherry, Date
print(fruits[-4:-1])  # Banana, Cherry, Date

blocks.alt: Fruits list ke paanch khaane: Apple, Banana, Cherry, Date, Elderberry. Oopar musbat index 0 se 4, neeche manfi index -5 se -1. Banana, Cherry aur Date ke neeche qaus (bracket) par likha hai fruits[1:4] = fruits[-4:-1].
blocks.caption: Musbat aur manfi index: dono tareeqon se ek hi cheezein milti hain (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).
